request.voice_description: An original male German action-game fighter, age 40. Deep resonant stern baritone with a compact chesty growl. Recognisable German accent in fluent intelligible English: crisp consonants, firm rhythm and German vowel shapes. Methodical, blunt, impatient, very dry humour; sudden forceful bursts when hurt or provoked. Short naturally pronounced German interjections mixed with English. Energetic physical video-game acting, not narration. Clean dry close microphone, no music, no background, no reverb. No imitation of a real person.
